capabilities: Connect AI agents to live editor context
Provide in-editor AI assistants and inline completion
Run an embedded terminal and Vim engine
Manage Git repositories from the vault
Edit source files and open external files
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. API keys are stored as plain text in the vault's data.json. mv-agent carries a maintenance notice due to frequent breaking changes in DSH. Full documentation lives in an external feature guide.
problem: Obsidian lacks the AI agents, embedded terminal, source-code tooling, and desktop file workflows of a full IDE.

relations.evidence: Claude Code, Codex CLI, and any MCP agent can read active tabs, selections, diagnostics, terminal output
Claude Code, Codex CLI, general MCP clients, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) are supported.
Claude Code, Codex CLI, general MCP clients, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) are supported.
Source Assist's Code Suite kernel is based on obsidian-latex-suite 1.11.5 with its MIT notice preserved.
The CodeMirror architecture of Inline Completion was informed by the public design of obsidian-github-copilot
the terminal process bridge by obsidian-claude-sidebar
The Git integration's command design and testing approach were informed by Obsidian Git (MIT)
configuration UX were informed by the public documentation and user-visible ideas of obsidian-vimrc-support and Vim Motions

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex CLI, or an MCP agent

summary: All-in-one AI IDE that adds coding agents, in-editor AI, a terminal, Vim, source tools, a file opener, and Git to Obsidian.
